name: DCLA Programs Funding
description:
This dataset lists funding awards made to arts and cultural organizations through a city cultural programs initiative. Each row represents a single application, identified by an application code that includes a fiscal year prefix (for example, FY12-AN-009139), the name of the applying organization, and the total final award amount in dollars. The sample covers 5,000 applications from 1,234 distinct organizations, with awards ranging from about $2,955 to $885,870 and a median in the low tens of thousands of dollars.

The data can be used to analyze how program funding is distributed across organizations, compare award sizes, identify organizations that received multiple grants, and track funding patterns by fiscal year using the application code prefix. It supports reporting on grant-making equity, budget planning, and research into public support for the arts and recreation sector.
